messages:
Ivy: quick micro-challenge — desk feng shui edition. share ONE tiny thing you do at your desk that actually improves your day. keep it micro. 
Owen: always keep a small glass of water in view. hydration reminder = sanity :droplet:
Priya: two sticky tabs: 'today' + 'done' — move stuff from one to the other. tiny dopamine hit.
Jamal: one pointless desk plant. I call mine 'Audit' and it judges me less than my inbox. :seedling:
Sofia: headphones on, low white noise (rain playlist). disappears open-office chaos.
Owen: +1 on the 'done' tab. also a single candy bowl for emergencies. not shared with the plants.
Ivy: love the candy policy. also — put a single photo of a weird vacation spot. instant mood reset during meetings.
Priya: tiny desk lamp with warm light. battle for the corner of my soul at 3pm.
Jamal: reminder: angle your monitor a little left so sunlight hits peripheral, not screen. tiny but huge.
Sofia: a handwritten 3-word mantra taped under my mousepad. visible only when I fumble. feels like a secret.
KernelsBot: scheduled reminder — 'Stand up & stretch' at 15:30 daily. (uses office calendar)
Ivy: this is gold. quick poll — which is the best micro-tip here? react with :one: water, :two: done tab, :three: plant, :four: white noise, :five: lamp, :six: mantra.
Owen: :one: :thumbsup:
Priya: :two: all the way
Jamal: :three: for morale
Sofia: :four: helps focus
Ivy: thanks everyone. tiny rituals FTW. also tagging @office-gifts — who wants to curate a ‘micro comforts’ desk kit?
